content:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

# Least-privilege by default: no job here pushes or writes back to the repo.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Trimmed generated-repo CI: build · lint · unit · golden-file for the installed modules.
# Caisson's internal release machinery and authoring checks are not part of a generated repo and are
# intentionally absent from this workflow — this is yours to extend.
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run build

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run lint

  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun test ./src

  golden:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      # Golden-file regression with BLESS unset — any drift in a committed baseline fails here.
      - run: bun test ./src

node_modules/
.next/
*.log
.DS_Store

# AGENTS — acme-app

Generated by `create-caisson` (Next.js App Router starter). This is the agent-facing contract for
working in this repo: the modules you installed and the invariants they ship with.

## Installed modules

- `@caisson-sh/credits` @ 0.2.0
- `@caisson-sh/field-crypto` @ 0.1.0

## Wired examples (replace, don't extend blindly)

- `src/lib/auth.ts` / `src/proxy.ts` / `src/app/api/me/route.ts` — account-JWT session
  verification (Ed25519, `@caisson-sh/auth`), a proxy (Next 16's `middleware.ts` rename) and a Route
  Handler using it.
- `src/lib/db.ts` / `src/app/actions/notes.ts` — a `pg`-backed `Transactor` and a Server Action
  scoping every query through `withTenant` (`@caisson-sh/tenancy-rls`).
- `src/app/api/billing/webhook/route.ts` — a `BillingProvider`-port webhook stub
  (`@caisson-sh/billing`); the concrete driver is the commercial `@caisson-sh/billing-orchestration`.
- `src/lib/jobs.ts` / `src/app/actions/notify.ts` — a `JobQueue` port example
  (`@caisson-sh/jobs`).
- `src/lib/email.ts` — an `Emailer` port example (`@caisson-sh/email`).
- `src/lib/ai.ts` — a provider-agnostic AI lane resolver (`@caisson-sh/ai-config`).

## Invariants (inherited from Caisson)

- TypeScript strict; Bun runtime + package manager (never npm/yarn).
- Zod `.strict()` at every boundary; no `any`, no `console.log` in product code.
- `crypto.randomUUID()` for ids; `crypto.timingSafeEqual` for secret/token compares; integer
  credits/money (never floats).
- Tenant data ALWAYS goes through `withTenant`/`withUser` — never a raw query against a
  tenant-scoped table.
- Golden-file regression: the `src/__golden__/` fixtures are committed baselines — review every
  diff, never blind-bless.

## Working in this repo

- `bun install` then `bun test` — the suite is green from clone.
- Add your product code under `src/`; keep new boundaries Zod-validated.
- The installed `@caisson-sh/*` modules are versioned dependencies, not vendored source — upgrade
  them through `package.json`, never by editing inside `node_modules`.

# acme-app

Generated by `create-caisson` with the **Next.js App Router** starter (`--framework next`).

## Installed modules

- `@caisson-sh/credits` @ 0.2.0
- `@caisson-sh/field-crypto` @ 0.1.0

Every module installs from the public npm registry — no token or registry configuration needed.

## Wired examples

Each file below is a small, working example — not a framework. Read it, then replace it with your
own logic.

| Concern       | Files                                                        |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Auth          | `src/lib/auth.ts`, `src/proxy.ts`, `src/app/api/me/route.ts` |
| Tenancy (RLS) | `src/lib/db.ts`, `src/app/actions/notes.ts`                  |
| Billing       | `src/app/api/billing/webhook/route.ts`                       |
| Jobs          | `src/lib/jobs.ts`, `src/app/actions/notify.ts`               |
| Email         | `src/lib/email.ts`                                           |
| AI config     | `src/lib/ai.ts`                                              |

Set `AUTH_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY` (the base64 SPKI DER public half from `@caisson-sh/auth`'s
`generateAccountKeyPair()`) and `DATABASE_URL` before the auth/tenancy examples do anything real;
`RESEND_API_KEY`/`RESEND_FROM` switch email off the in-memory capture driver.

## Scripts

- `bun install` — install the `@caisson-sh/*` modules you composed in, plus Next/React.
- `bun run dev` — start the dev server.
- `bun run build` — production build (typechecks as part of the build).
- `bun run start` — serve the production build.
- `bun run lint` — oxlint.
- `bun test` — unit tests + golden-file regression for the installed modules.

## CI

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs `build`, `lint`, `unit`, and `golden` on every push and pull
request. This is your repo — extend it freely.

  "dependencies": {

    "@caisson-sh/auth": "^0.4.5",
    "@caisson-sh/billing": "^0.6.9",
    "@caisson-sh/credits": "0.2.0",
    "@caisson-sh/email": "^0.5.8",
    "@caisson-sh/field-crypto": "0.1.0",
    "@caisson-sh/jobs": "^0.7.4",
    "@caisson-sh/kernel": "^0.10.0",
    "@caisson-sh/tenancy-rls": "^0.6.1",
    "next": "^16.3.3",
    "pg": "^8.16.0",
    "react": "^19.2.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/bun": "^1.1.14",

    "@types/pg": "^8.11.10",

  },

  "scripts": {
    "build": "next build",
    "dev": "next dev",
    "lint": "oxlint .",

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "types": ["bun", "node"],
    "strict": true,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
    "allowJs": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "jsx": "preserve",
    "incremental": true,
    "plugins": [{ "name": "next" }],
    "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }
  },
  "include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "next.config.ts",
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "src/**/*.tsx",
    ".next/types/**/*.ts"
  ],
  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
}
